acceptance_criteria.statement: Policy provenance is deeply immutable, internally digest-consistent and binds proposal lifetime semantics.
Input and m4r1 integrity/scope failures reject before proposal persistence or provider write.
Authentication and path-Workspace authorization observably precede proposal lookup.
Only currently authorized humans decide; model/system cannot approve and separation of duties is policy-selected.
Concurrent approve/reject has exactly one atomic durable winner.
PostgreSQL fully reconstructs immutable provenance/audit and every material replacement gets new proposal and logical identities.
Production composition derives policy-selected digest-bound expiry and every denial, stale and expiry projection survives PostgreSQL-backed restart/reload.
One canonical-json-v1 implementation serves all tool consumers; reconciled #75 composition is exercised with an explicit zero-count provider-write sentinel.

design_decisions.decision: Core #76 workflow depends only on CapabilityResolver and ProposalTargetVerifier; integration composition may use accepted #75 concrete registry/reference seams.
Proposal, caller/proposal/approval actors, capability, binding, policy, reference, parameters and logical execution identity are immutable and distinct.
Policy-selected expiry is server-derived from trusted policy semantics and covered by the policy digest; no unbound fallback lifetime is permitted.
Issue #76 performs no provider write and adds no execution or reconciliation behavior.

invariants: Authentication and Workspace authorization occur before a proposal lookup, with zero lookups on denied requests.
Model and system actors never approve.
Material proposal fields and append-only audit cannot be edited.
Human approval does not grant execution authority.
Every reported provider-write count is produced by an installed counting sentinel.
Each denial, stale and expiry projection is observed before and after PostgreSQL-backed composition recreation.
Prior v3 and v4 review and Evaluation history remains append-only.

test_cases.statement: Attempt source, top-level and nested policy mutation before/after proposal creation and reload.
test_cases.oracle: Snapshot cannot change; recomputed and persisted policy digests match; lifetime semantics remain bound.

test_cases.statement: Run complete invalid parameter, forbidden-field and m4r1 integrity/scope/store matrix.
test_cases.oracle: Closed safe errors occur before rows or provider writes; all counters remain zero.

test_cases.statement: Use an ordered counting proposal-lookup sentinel for unauthenticated, wrong-Workspace and authorized-absent operations.
test_cases.oracle: Denied requests perform zero lookups; an authorized request records successful authorization before exactly one scoped lookup; no denied mutation/write occurs.

test_cases.statement: Exercise human/model/system authority, explicit SoD on/off and reject-reason matrix.
test_cases.oracle: Only permitted human decisions persist; unknown reason fails before persistence; approval grants no execution authority.

test_cases.statement: Release concurrent approve/reject against one expected revision and retry both.
test_cases.oracle: Exactly one decision/audit winner and one revision increment; all others return persisted winner.

test_cases.statement: Restart PostgreSQL store, compare every provenance/decision/audit field, attempt forbidden mutations and create material replacements.
test_cases.oracle: Exact reconstruction, database mutation rejection, new proposal/logical IDs and no inherited approval.

test_cases.statement: For temporary execution denial, each capability/binding/policy mismatch and expiry, record the typed projection before and after recreating the PostgreSQL-backed composition.
test_cases.oracle: Every before/after pair is identical and bound to the same durable proposal; denial stays approved/non-stale, material mismatch is stale and expiry is typed; no execution/reconciliation/write call occurs.

test_cases.statement: Inspect canonical imports, run conformance plus focused/full/migration/lint/Compose checks with explicit counting sentinel.
test_cases.oracle: Single canonical implementation, narrow core protocols, accepted #75 integration, zero provider writes and all governed checks green.

command_projections.statement: Clean Alembic upgrade using the pinned Python runtime and serialized PostgreSQL database.
Focused Issue #76 pytest suites followed by the complete repository pytest suite.
Ruff and Docker Compose configuration verification.

required_evidence.statement: Mutation matrix and policy snapshot/digest/expiry calculation.
Sanitized HTTP/input/reference/authority/concurrency matrices, ordered authorization/lookup traces, per-call lookup counts and zero rejected-row counts.
Field-by-field PostgreSQL reconstruction, database guards, replacement identities and ordered audit.
Production composition dependency trace and condition-by-condition before/after-restart denial/stale/expiry projection matrix with durable identity.
Canonical import inventory, exact verification exits/totals/migration head and explicit sentinel identity with write count zero.

prior_findings.problem: Shallowly mutable policy semantics could diverge from their digest.
prior_findings.required_change: Deeply freeze/copy canonical policy semantics and prove nested mutation cannot change persisted authority.

prior_findings.problem: Guide v3 conflicted with accepted #75 integration and reported a zero write count without a counting sentinel.
prior_findings.required_change: Reconcile the integration boundary and require an installed counting sentinel for the zero-write oracle.

prior_findings.problem: Production used a one-hour fallback not selected by attested policy.
prior_findings.required_change: Bind typed lifetime semantics into policy provenance and test a non-default lifetime through production composition.

prior_findings.problem: PostgreSQL tests did not prove full reconstruction, replacements or durable stale/expiry projections.
prior_findings.required_change: Require field-by-field reload, replacement identity and durable projection evidence.

prior_findings.problem: Proposal code duplicated the canonical-json-v1 implementation already owned by knora.tools.contracts.
prior_findings.required_change: Use one canonical implementation and one conformance suite across all tool consumers.

prior_findings.problem: HTTP 401/403/404 outcomes alone did not prove that denied requests performed no proposal lookup.
prior_findings.required_change: Require an ordered counting proposal-lookup sentinel with zero denied lookups and authorization before exactly one authorized scoped lookup.

prior_findings.problem: Guide v4 did not explicitly re-observe every denial, mismatch and expiry projection after PostgreSQL-backed restart.
prior_findings.required_change: Require a before/after restart pair with identical typed projection and durable identity for each condition.
